manuscript_title: Pendulum Period at the small-angle rig

evidence.quote: Under quiet conditions, the timer measured 15 s at the small-angle rig.
The comparison uses a reference timer at the same small-angle rig.

rows.text: Both protocols concern the small-angle rig. The field record gives 15 s, while the separate reference checks the instrument in that setting.
rows.difference: The field observation and the separate reference use distinct instruments.
rows.gap: The earlier protocol recorded pendulum period at the small-angle rig only under quiet conditions.
rows.response: We report a bounded measurement of 15 s.
rows.boundary: Only the quiet condition was observed; the pendulum period outside that condition was not measured.
